chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “There are four things; whoever they are in him, he will be in the greatest light of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
One whose safeguard in his affair is the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah,
and one who, when a calamity befalls him, says:
“Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we are returning.”
And one who, when some good reaches him, says:
“All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds.”
And one who, when he commits a sin, says:
“I seek forgiveness from Allah and I repent to Him.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعٌ: Four qualities or matters mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِهِ: The safeguard and protection of one’s affair
key_terms.مُصِيبَةٌ: A calamity or affliction that befalls a person
key_terms.نُورِ ٱللَّهِ: The divine light, meaning Allah’s guidance, protection, and favor
key_terms.ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: Praise and gratitude belong to Allah

ai.seo_question: What qualities bring a person into the greatest light of Allah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches four foundational responses that keep a believer in divine light: affirming shahadah, showing patience at calamity, expressing gratitude at blessing, and seeking forgiveness after sin. It joins creed, remembrance, gratitude, and tawbah as core qualities of a God-conscious life.
